_about: Tentative reading list for the 2027 cohort, loaded from RUNBOOK.md Appendix R (rule R5). Status 'tentative' until Jared edits this file and re-runs node scripts/build-readings.mjs. Policy (PEDAGOGY 13.1, 2026-10-11): Wolfram plus at least one added reading per session; about one video per two sessions, watched before class. source_key names the SOURCES.md record each item cites; Phase 10 adds the missing records with kind assigned_reading. Each row's confidence is the SOURCES.md record's confidence (how far the item itself was verified) and is rendered as the chip on the card.
